jobs.occupation: Electrical Engineer for Power Plant Applications (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
What You Will Do:

- Manage electrical engineering activities across the full project lifecycle, from concept and basic engineering through detailed design, installation, commissioning, and final acceptance
- Plan, design, and engineer electrical systems for power generation applications, ensuring solutions meet project requirements, customer expectations, and industry standards
- Develop electrical and control system concepts, including medium- and low-voltage systems, power distribution, protection systems, and control technologies
- Prepare and review electrical documentation such as circuit diagrams, technical specifications, load calculations, cable sizing, and protection coordination studies
- Ensure all engineering deliverables are accurate, compliant with regulations, and aligned with project timelines and quality standards
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, process, and automation engineering) to integrate electrical systems into overall plant design effectively
- Support installation, commissioning, and testing activities, providing technical expertise, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring reliable operation of power generation equipment

What You Have (Key Skills/Experience Required):

- Several years of experience designing and engineering electrical systems within industrial, power generation, marine, or large-scale plant environments
- Strong expertise in medium- and low-voltage systems, electrical protection, power distribution, and international standards such as IEC and VDE
- Proven capability in performing electrical calculations, developing system designs, and managing comprehensive engineering documentation
- Proficiency in engineering tools such as EPLAN, AutoCAD, or comparable CAD software for electrical design and documentation.
- A structured, independent, and solution-driven approach, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail in complex engineering environments
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a willingness to travel internationally (~20%) to support global project execution.
- Proficiency both in English and in German (spoken and written)

What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):

- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- Hands-on experience with automation and control systems for marine engines, including knowledge of bus communication (e.g., Modbus RTU/TCP, CANbus) and control engineering principles

What You Will Get

- Varied, responsible, and challenging tasks
- Excellent earning opportunities according to the Caterpillar compensation system
- 30 days of vacation
- Company pension plan
- Bicycle leasing / job ticket

jobs.occupation: Test Engineer RF Production Test Systems (m/f/d) for Wireless and Embedded Products (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Principal Responsibilities:

- Designs and develops software applications and automation in support of manufacturing and engineering services.
- Provides input during engineering design and support reviews and prototype builds on functional requirements, product designs and potential issues as it relates to testing and manufacturing.
- Collaborates with design engineering and customer operations to establish new or redesign existing service programs.
- Ensures product meets internal and external quality requirements and customer specifications.
- Creates support and repair procedures and processes, writes troubleshooting guides and develops testing techniques.
- Trains operations personnel on support and manufacturing processes, product schematics, Approved Vendor Lists (AVL), Bill of Materials (BOM) drivers, applications and firmware functions.
- Compiles and maintains test-related documentation including test plans, procedures, results and reports.
- Identifies, investigates, and participates in opportunities to improve processes and procedures, to include various key performance metrics.
- Other duties as assigned.

Job Level Specifications:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Technical Computer Science, or a related field.
- Solid experience in RF and embedded hardware development, including understanding of RF design principles.
- Proven proficiency in test design and automation tools (e.g. Agilent ADS, Keysight VEE, LabVIEW, Visual Studio, Python).
- Hands-on experience with measurement and test equipment (e.g. network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, protocol tester).
- Familiarity with regulatory standards and certification processes (ETSI, FCC, CE, RED, PTCRB).
- Basic knowledge of embedded firmware and hardware interfaces (e.g. SPI, I²C, PCIe, UART) is an advantage.
- Experience with DFM/DFT and structured development processes is beneficial.
- Analytical and structured working style with strong problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

#Li-Tria
Work Experience:

- Typically 3+ years with bachelor's or equivalent.

Education and Certification(s):

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

Distinguishing Characteristics:

- May be required to travel.

Essential Functions

- Good understanding and experience with the development of mechanical design, manufacturing technologies, and embedding of electro-mechanical systems which may include vision systems, sensors, motors, enclosures, mounts and/or the integration of illumination, imager optics and electronics.
- Designs of parts and small sub-systems.
- Performance tests to check if the design meets specifications.
- Model interfaces with electronic and optical systems. Model thermal properties of the mounts and their interfaces. Model the design response to environmental shock and vibration.
- Definition of requirements and specifications for systems and components.
- Creation of drawings and specifications for optical and mechanical parts.
- Hands-on mentality.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Actively involved in engineering discussions. Ability to pro-actively communicate clearly, both orally and in writing in order to be actively involved in cross-functional discussions.
- Solid problem-solving skills for mechanical problems on a (sub-)system level. Strong attention to detail with the ability to debug, root cause, qualify, and modify electro-mechanical assemblies. Can effectively implement when given design direction.
- Knowledge of – or experience with mechanical production technologies, particularly injection molding, die casting, vacuum forming
- Possess strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to multitask multiple projects with quality and efficiency in a dynamic and fast-moving industry.
- Innovative and creative-minded individual who looks to continuously improve and challenge the ways things are done.
- Independent self-starter as well as a conscientious team player. Solid interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders to achieve project deliverables.
- Experience creating and maintaining BOMs, mechanical drawings, and assembly/process documentation.
- Exposure working with vendors for custom components and sourcing specific hardware for designs.
- Ability to use mechanical simulation tools (strength or thermal) or experience with designing optical or electrical systems.
- Experience prototyping your own designs using various fabrication equipment: mills, lathes, CNC systems, hand tools, 3D printers, laser cutters.

Minimum Education and Work Experience Required

- Typically requires 2-4+ years of mechanical product/design engineering experience or relevant technical experience. Experience with 3D CAD system preferably SolidWorks or equivalent.
- B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred), technical discipline (i.e. Robotics Engineering, Industrial Design), or relevant equivalent professional experience.
- Must possess English language proficiency as a minimum for the role.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Do you want to shape how a global manufacturing network thinks about data, AI, and the cloud? As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) Cloud & AI, you will  work within the Process Digitalization unit, you will design end-to-end solutions on Microsoft Azure and Snowflake that power production, sales, and finance domains alike. Also, you will lead the implementation of AI-driven workflows, e.g. integrating Azure OpenAI, building ML pipelines, and modernizing legacy systems, while also guiding executive leadership on strategic priorities. Every day, you'll balance ambitious architectural thinking with the satisfaction of shipping real, scalable solutions that move the organization toward a truly cloud-native future.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Designing scalable, secure Azure and Snowflake architectures by translating complex requirements from the global manufacturing network into future-proof cloud solutions
* Leading hands-on implementation of cloud and ML solutions by integrating Azure OpenAI into live data workflows and deploying robust CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps
* Driving modernization of legacy systems and automate data flows across production, sales, and finance domains to support a leaner, cloud-native organization
* Acting as a senior thought leader and sparring partner for Azure-based applications, owning the documentation and scaling of architectural designs across the organization
* Communicate architectural strategies and project outcomes clearly to both executive leadership and technical teams, bridging vision and delivery with confidence

What You Bring

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Cloud Engineering, or a related field, paired with many years of experience in cloud architecture
* Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure and Snowflake including AI/ML integration, Python, SQL, and API development with a proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions
* Strong strategic planning and influencing skills: you're as comfortable shaping a multi-year architecture roadmap as you are aligning stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), generative AI services, and cloud-based modernization of enterprise systems
* You are business fluent in English; fluency in German is a strong plus

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

For Applicants applying from Austria:

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of 54.439,39 € gross/year for a full-time position (38,5 h/week).

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Challenge

In your role as Process Engineer, you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory. You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process optimization and further development of reactor hardware. In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes coompley test series with development projects
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribtuion to ensuring our customers' rapid success

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment
- You have good written and spoken English skills
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%)

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON

At Innolume, we develop innovative optoelectronic semiconductor technologies that power next-generation communication and sensing applications worldwide.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) who will work across our locations in Eindhoven and Dortmund and is comfortable traveling regularly between both sites.

In this role, you will modernize our software landscape, develop scalable applications, and connect software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment. Your work will directly support the development and production of cutting-edge photonic semiconductor devices while helping shape the next generation of our digital engineering environment.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to see your software making a tangible impact in a high-tech manufacturing environment, we would love to meet you.

Build the Software behind tomorrow's Semiconductor Technology:
• Design, develop and maintain software for automated measurement, equipment control and data acquisition
• Build scalable desktop applications and software architectures for engineering and manufacturing
• Modernise legacy software applications and migrate existing LabVIEW solutions to sustainable software platforms
• Integrate laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, databases, MES and ERP systems
• Develop reliable software interfaces and efficient data pipelines
• Improve software quality, maintainability and performance using modern engineering principles
• Troubleshoot complex software-hardware interactions in close collaboration with engineering teams

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a young, innovative university in the middle of the Metropole Ruhr. Excellent in research and teaching, we think in terms of possibilities instead of limits and develop ideas with a future. We live diversity, promote potential and are committed to educational equity.
The University of Duisburg-Essen invites applications for the position of a
PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (gross 38.265 – 54.388 €)
at the Faculty of Chemistry, Institute for Physical Chemistry (located at the campus in Essen).
The Faculty of Chemistry at the UDE is one of the largest chemistry faculties in Germany and offers three study programs under one roof: Chemistry, Water Science and Chemistry Teachers College. The young and dynamic research group led by Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt focuses on elucidating the structures and reactions of transition-metal enzymes with computer simulations, thereby bridging the fields of computational chemistry and quantum crystallography.

Your tasks

You will conduct research within the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing” as part of the NRW Return Programme of Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt. The main focus of your position will be on evaluating quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) calculations on metalloenzymes and exploring whether machine learning can be used for predictions of enzymatic reactions in biomass and plastic degradation. In these areas, you will closely collaborate with postdoctoral and PhD researchers who have experience in QM/MM calculations of metalloenzymes and machine learning. Additionally, you will contribute to supervising students, teaching activities, and administrative tasks, aligned with your transferable skill development.

Your profile

- By the time of appointment, you will have successfully completed your university studies in chemistry, biochemistry, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, biology, physics or a related field with a standard period of study of at least eight semesters (minimum 270 credit points or equivalent) and an average grade of at least ‘good’ (or equivalent)
- You are highly motivated to pursue research in sustainable chemistry and push the boundaries of computational biochemistry
- Ideally, you have first experience in QM calculations and their analysis. Experience with QM/MM or QM-cluster calculations on enzymes is desirable but not required; you are eager to learn these methods
- Previous experience in the use of machine learning and/or QM software packages, high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, and Linux operating systems will be considered an advantage
- You demonstrate scientific curiosity, take responsibility for your own work, and actively contribute to team-oriented, interdisciplinary, and international collaborations inside and outside the research group. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential
The position offers the opportunity for further scientific qualification.

We offer

- An interesting and responsible research position with broad opportunities for academic and personal growth, allowing you to take responsibility and establish valuable connections with academic and industrial collaborators locally as well as internationally
- A supportive and appreciative working atmosphere within a highly motivated, international and diverse research group. We look forward to welcoming and onboarding our new team member
- Fully funded participation in national and international workshops, summer schools, and conferences as well as dedicated presentation training
- Training in state-of-the-art computational methods and software (e.g., ORCA, AMBER) as well as access to significant HPC resources (e.g., the cluster AmplitUDE (https://escience-wissr.gitpages.uni-due.de/hpc-support/content/amplitUDE/amplitude_hardware.html) )
- Access to graduate courses, transferable skills training and the possibility to apply for the Water Graduate School (WGS (https://www.uni-due.de/zwu/wgs.php) )
- Family-friendly policies, including childcare support
- Advisory services for employees with family care responsibilities
- Possibility to enrol as a student, granting access to student housing, local public transport throughout Germany (Deutschlandsemesterticket (https://www.uni-due.de/faq-studium/semesterticket_en.php) ) and discounts at university canteens, museums, etc.
- Excellent public transport connections and free parking
- Access to attractive sports and health programs (university sports)
- The possibility of remote work
Starting date: 01.12.2026
Contract period: 36 months (3 years) with the possibility of extension
Working time: 67% of a full-time employment (part-time employment is possible)
Application deadline: 25.09.2026
Please submit your application (motivation letter, CV, diplomas, transcript of records with grades, at least two references) quoting reference 416-26 to: Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt, Universität Duisburg-Essen, Fakultät für Chemie, Campus Essen, 45117 Essen. Please compile your application in a single PDF file and send it via email to applications.wieduwilt@uni-due.de.
Additional information about our research and group can be found at:
- About the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing”: https://www.uni-due.de/2025-12-08-professor-erna-wieduwilt-researches-plastic-recycling
- About the group: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk)
- Current webpage: https://www.uni-due.de/zmb/members/erna-wieduwilt.php
The University of Duisburg-Essen is committed to promoting diversity among its members (see https://www.uni-due.de/diversity/en/). It aims to increase the number of women in academic positions and therefore explicitly encourages qualified women to apply. Women will be given preference in accordance with the North Rhine-Westphalia State Equality Act (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW) if they have equivalent qualifications. Applications from suitable severely disabled persons and persons of equal status within the meaning of Section 2 (3) SGB IX are welcome.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Join our dynamic team at Boehringer Ingelheim as a Customer Experience (CX) Head, TA. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic linchpin, leveraging data to enrich decision-making and uncovering new business opportunities within the TA. Working in close collaboration with the TA Head and a standing member of the Brand Team, you will drive customer-centric initiatives for Human Pharma Germany. If you're passionate about shaping customer experiences and have a knack for strategic thinking, we'd love to hear from you.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As the primary point of contact, you will engage with the TA Head and Brand Team, acting as a strategic sparring partner.
- You will be responsible for converting strategic and high-level tactical features into smaller, actionable user stories.
- Strong capabilities for business case and LRR development by evaluating on-going operational requirement against existing resource and capabilities
- Integral analytical support for OL, ACV and LTF planning process and preparations on a strategic level
- Involvement in business cases and LRR development will be a key part of your role, as you evaluate ongoing operational requirements against existing resources and capabilities.
- Overall management and leadership of 4-6 direct reports (incl people development) for the functional areas related to Project Management, Training & Development, Customer Insights & Forecasting, and Sales Force Effectiveness.
- Establishing strategic and cooperative relationships with various functions within HP Business Operations and cross-functional teams will be a major part of your role.
- You will serve as a liaison between various functions and groups (Brand Team, HP Operations Group Heads and Squad Leads), influencing stakeholders to improve productivity, manage necessary changes, and support key business projects.
- Direct reporting line to Head of Human Pharma Operations, Human Pharma Germany.

Requirements

- Doctoral degree (e.g., PhD, MD) and/or a Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) or diploma degree
- Possess experience in a leadership or people manager role, including in-depth knowledge of the German human pharmaceutical market
- Exhibit excellent relationship-building skills and conflict management with above-average oral, written, and presentation skills
- Demonstrate the ability to drive change, manage organizational transformations, and proactively implement innovation
- Have experience in Commercial (Sales and/or Marketing), Training, Business Analyst roles.
- Possess the ability to lead and steer different functions and can lead without authority within a TAs
- Be capable of simplifying complex topics and providing clear actionable next steps.
- Exhibit strength in being a solution-driven leader to address issues/challenges and lead the team to move forward together
- Possess strong people management skills - inspires and develops growth for team members

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 18.09.2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to 11.09.2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join our Compression Regional Service Sales within Siemens Energy TI Compression as a Client Manager supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors.

The Client Manager is the owner of the client relationship, and is responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction, meeting client requirements and driving Services bookings growth within their respective territory. He/she leads all aspects of business and opportunity development from the initial stages through order entry. 

This position is primarily focused on Germany (Western & Eastern part) market and reports to the Head of Sales REGION WE, SWE, NORDICS and GERMANY.

You will be involved in some of the most exciting and challenging service and modernization projects within these industries. This is a highly networked role that requires an ability to work under challenging deadlines. 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and manage long-term relationships with assigned clients
* Proactively and systematically prospect the market aiming to generate new leads and opportunities.
* Understand the evaluation and decision-making process of customers and develop a strategy to position Siemens Energy ahead of the competition. 
* Develop and execute the sales capture plan (annual plan) and strategy around each customer in your responsibilities, incorporating the customer needs, equipment application, Siemens Energy strengths, competitor’s weaknesses and a robust market level pricing recommendation based on the assessment of competitive position.
* Identify advanced business opportunities (LMU) and support RPDM in developing and successfully closing such opportunities.
* Identify, create and maintain a robust opportunity pipeline in Salesforce to support overall business sales target. Own the Sales target in the assigned territory. Effectively manage opportunities via CRM Tool (Salesforce.com), ensuring opportunities are regularly updated
* Maintain the accuracy (within SFDC) of the entire installed equipment population, including operating status and planned outages, and client data in the assigned territory
* Prepare, coordinate and conduct proposal negotiations until closure of the opportunities in cooperation with other involved professionals
* Conduct Win/Loss analyses and provide input to fighting guides and regional competitive analyses.
* Provide voice of the client needs/competitive intelligence, market drivers and buying influences for the development of new product and service offerings

What You Bring

* Proven track record in driving results, delivering on growth strategies and proactive creation & conversion of sales opportunities in complex market environments
* Bachelor of Science in Engineering required with a minimum 5 years of experience in Energy industry and at least 3 years in sales/business development role.
* Turbomachinery experience/knowledge is mandatory, strong technical understanding of industrial compressors is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and interact with all levels within customer organization, strong analytical and strategic problem solver with a focus on technical differentiation and value selling
* Proficient in communication, both written and spoken, be able to discuss technical and commercial aspects.
* Willingness to travel as required.(50% and more)
* Business German andd English speaking and writing skills are necessary.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
